task: Add a public byte-stable REST export endpoint GET /v1/export/{kind}/{id} for six kinds (incl. about eleven datasource types) producing re-applicable documents with names for ids and env: credential references.

key_reasoning.reason: New shared export serialiser plus per-kind exporters for assistant, workflow, datasource, integration, skill and category, a name-resolution/ambiguity layer, env: reference derivation, and a workflow yaml_config inverse converter; new abstractions across several routers.

Closest pattern is the Node IaC backup, which writes credential values and is non-deterministic, so it does not cover secret handling or byte-stability. No backend precedent for deterministic serialisation. About seven datasource exporters (xray, azure_devops_wiki, azure_devops_work_item, git_faq, sharepoint, xwiki, provider) have no converter to copy. Credentials must never leak, and the PUT-body round-trip guarantee carries destructive full-replace risk. Enumerated edge cases (ambiguity, mask handling, companion files) have no existing test template.

Six entity routers plus a new export router and registration in main.py, a serialiser core, about eleven datasource exporters, workflow converter and reference resolver, plus golden-vector, round-trip and negative-path tests: well over 16 files with many new ones.

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk held at XL: security/credentials requirement (secrets must never appear as values) and a security-handling gap in the closest precedent
Component Scope XL: affects multiple entity workflows and routers
